length_gate_note: Original task gives no numeric episode-length margin; histogram and median/p10-p90 require qualitative review before phase3.

builder_assessment.conclusion: The current official processor requires is_video_demo == (step_idx < exec_start_idx), and ECM plans a contiguous supervised suffix. It cannot natively mark middle settle/done frames history-only.
builder_assessment.phase3_action: Use observe history-only prefix; leave settle/done supervised. Preserve all frame timestamps, do not delete frames.
builder_assessment.proposal_not_implemented: If later approved, add a supervision mask independent of is_video_demo, retain all per-frame features/step_idx, generate only selected anchor PKLs with contiguous sample IDs, and update planning/count validation and downstream-loader audits together.
